description:
If you looked at this server and decided NOT to use it — this tool is
    for you. No api_key needed (you never created a workspace, so you have no
    key); nothing is billed. One honest call tells the operator what stopped
    you, which is the one signal they cannot otherwise see. Rate-limited per
    IP; please call once, don't retry-loop it. Returns {signal_id, status}.

contact.description: Optional way to reach you (the operator never replies otherwise).
contact.title: Contact

detail.description: Optional free-text detail for the operator.
detail.title: Detail

signal.description: Why you are NOT using this service: one of "no_use_case", "payment_barrier", "missing_feature", "trust_concern", "pricing", "docs_unclear", "just_looking", "other".
